scoring_justification: T0 result-level comparison against paper-reported Table I values with tolerances. Recomputing DFT magnetic moments and MAE from raw wavefunctions/spin densities is infeasible in the verifier sandbox. Tolerances absorb expected toolchain spread while excluding random guesses.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for Ms, ML, EMAE from the paper's Table I.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from the paper's Table I (p. 2, main text).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Exact transcription of the published numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own experimental results; the reference solution reproduces them, and the task requires the agent to recompute them.

outputs.description: Computed magnetic properties of isolated MPc molecules: spin magnetic moment, orbital magnetic moment, and magnetic anisotropy energy.
